__about__: SchemaFlex schema for tau2 RETAIL (solo, 8B workhorse + sparse gpt-5.4 HILO on load-bearing extractions). v3: MULTI-TRANSACTION + CONDITIONAL. The request is parsed into a transaction QUEUE (PLAN_TXNS); POP_TARGET loads one transaction's action+order into the working registers; the LOAD->resolve->DO flow executes it; each DO advances to the next transaction (or sets resolved on the last). SKIP_TARGET drops a queued transaction whose precondition is unmet (e.g. cancel a non-pending order) so 'cancel all pending' works. The item walk (PLAN_CHANGES/WALK_VARIANT) handles multi-item; a conditional fallback in the walk switches a change to a cancel when no variant is available.
__conventions__: Parenthesis-free DNF predicates. Every transaction subtask is prefixed 'task_state.resolved == false'. Working registers (requested_action/order_id/order_status/item_ids/new_item_ids/change_plan/cancel_reason/new_address*) hold the CURRENT transaction; POP_TARGET sets them and clears the per-order ones. Fields the initializer must NOT fabricate are typed '<type>|null'.

retail.goal_template: complete all of the customer's retail requests: <goal>

fields.goal: string (full restatement of reason_for_call, including every requested action)
fields.customer_first: string|null (first name from known_info; for name+zip auth)
fields.customer_email: string|null (email ONLY if the scenario states one; if unknown/forgotten, null)
fields.tried_email: bool|null (set true by AUTH after an email lookup attempt)
fields.tried_name: bool|null (set true by AUTH after a name+zip lookup attempt)
fields.candidate_order_ids: list|null (JSON array of the customer's order ids; set by GET_USER)
fields.txn_queue: string|null (JSON array of the transactions to perform, each {"action":..., "order_id":...|null, "details":...}; set by PLAN_TXNS, consumed head-first by POP_TARGET; when the last is popped it becomes null)
fields.requested_action: string|null (the CURRENT transaction's action: 'cancel'|'modify_address'|'modify_payment'|'modify_user_address'|'modify_items'|'exchange'|'return'; set by POP_TARGET)
fields.txn_details: string|null (the current transaction's free-text details from the plan: which items / new options / new address / reason; set by POP_TARGET)
fields.order_id: string|null (the current transaction's order id; set by POP_TARGET or by LOAD_ORDER discovery)
fields.cancel_reason: string|null ('no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake') for a cancel
fields.payment_method_id: string|null (payment method for a difference/refund; default = the order's original, set by LOAD_ORDER)
fields.order_status: string|null (current order status; set by LOAD_ORDER; CLEARED by POP_TARGET)
fields.order_items: string|null (JSON array of the current order's items {item_id,product_id,name,options}; set by LOAD_ORDER; cleared by POP_TARGET)
fields.change_plan: string|null (JSON array of items to exchange/modify {old_item_id,product_id,desired_options}; set by PLAN_CHANGES, consumed by WALK_VARIANT; cleared by POP_TARGET)
fields.item_ids: string|null (JSON array of order item_ids being changed/returned; built by WALK_VARIANT / RESOLVE_RETURN_ITEMS; cleared by POP_TARGET)
fields.new_item_ids: string|null (JSON array of replacement item_ids, position-matched; built by WALK_VARIANT; cleared by POP_TARGET)
fields.resolved: bool (true ONLY when the LAST transaction succeeded and the queue is empty)
fields.escalated: bool (true once transferred to a human)

init_rules: goal: restate reason_for_call IN FULL, keeping every distinct request (the planner reads this).

customer_first, customer_last, customer_zip: from known_info (e.g. 'You are Yusuf Rossi in zip 19122' -> first='Yusuf', last='Rossi', zip='19122'). An id-style handle 'mei_kovacs_8020' -> first='mei', last='kovacs' (parts before the trailing number).
customer_email: set ONLY if the scenario explicitly gives an email; if it says unknown/forgotten, null.
Do NOT set txn_queue, requested_action, order_id or any transaction register at init — the planner (PLAN_TXNS) builds them from real order data.

base_subtask_sequence.name: auth
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.user_id == null and task_state.tried_email != true or task_state.user_id == null and task_state.tried_name != true

base_subtask_sequence.name: getUser
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.user_id != null and task_state.user_loaded == null

base_subtask_sequence.name: planTxns
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.user_loaded == true and task_state.txn_queue == null and task_state.requested_action == null

base_subtask_sequence.name: popTarget
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action == null and task_state.txn_queue != null

base_subtask_sequence.name: loadOrder
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action != null and task_state.requested_action != 'modify_user_address' and task_state.order_id != null and task_state.order_status == null

base_subtask_sequence.name: skipCancel
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action == 'cancel' and task_state.order_status != null and task_state.order_status != 'pending'

base_subtask_sequence.name: skipModify
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action == 'modify_address' and task_state.order_status != null and task_state.order_status != 'pending' or task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action == 'modify_payment' and task_state.order_status != null and task_state.order_status != 'pending' or task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action == 'modify_items' and task_state.order_status != null and task_state.order_status != 'pending'

base_subtask_sequence.name: skipDeliv
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action == 'exchange' and task_state.order_status != null and task_state.order_status != 'delivered' or task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action == 'return' and task_state.order_status != null and task_state.order_status != 'delivered'

base_subtask_sequence.name: planChanges
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.change_plan == null and task_state.new_item_ids == null and task_state.order_status == 'pending' and task_state.requested_action == 'modify_items' or task_state.resolved == false and task_state.change_plan == null and task_state.new_item_ids == null and task_state.order_status == 'delivered' and task_state.requested_action == 'exchange'

base_subtask_sequence.name: walkVariant
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.change_plan != null

base_subtask_sequence.name: resolveReturnItems
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action == 'return' and task_state.order_status == 'delivered' and task_state.item_ids == null

base_subtask_sequence.name: doCancel
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action == 'cancel' and task_state.order_status == 'pending'

base_subtask_sequence.name: doModifyAddress
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action == 'modify_address' and task_state.order_status == 'pending'

base_subtask_sequence.name: doModifyPayment
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action == 'modify_payment' and task_state.order_status == 'pending'

base_subtask_sequence.name: doModifyUserAddress
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action == 'modify_user_address' and task_state.user_id != null

base_subtask_sequence.name: doReturn
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action == 'return' and task_state.order_status == 'delivered' and task_state.item_ids != null

base_subtask_sequence.name: doExchange
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action == 'exchange' and task_state.order_status == 'delivered' and task_state.change_plan == null and task_state.new_item_ids != null

base_subtask_sequence.name: doModifyItems
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.requested_action == 'modify_items' and task_state.order_status == 'pending' and task_state.change_plan == null and task_state.new_item_ids != null

base_subtask_sequence.name: finalize
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.txn_queue == null and task_state.requested_action == null and task_state.user_loaded == true

base_subtask_sequence.name: escalate
base_subtask_sequence.when: task_state.resolved == false and task_state.escalated != true
